fun plan(): Evidence {
    val context = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val gather = readGather(context)
    val feedback = readFeedback(context)
    val scope = echoScope(gather)
    val verdict = echoVerdict(gather)
    val findings = gradeFindings(matrix = gather.matrix, feedback = feedback)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(leg = "spec-solves-issue", scope = scope, gatherVerdict = verdict, gradedFindings = findings, examined = findings.map { it.ref })
    val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", contents = evidence)
    val completion = noop(message = "No action needed: spec-solves-issue judge evidence written; gather was out of scope with no findings.")
    return evidence
}
